name: NIJIKA Firmware
authors: Anime4000, rajkosto, stich86, O3, et al.
summary: Firmware family for Realtek GPON hardware. NIJIKA runs on the vendor firmware of RTL9601 sticks. NIJIKA-Luna moves the stick to an open base. NijikaWrt runs OpenWrt on a full ONT gateway.
features: Interoperates with major OLT vendors across regional operators
Metrics export to Prometheus and Grafana

variants.name: NIJIKA-Luna
variants.base: RTL9601 OSS, Linux 6.18, open switch, GPON and OMCI drivers. Nijika UI, nijika CLI in C, trial boot with automatic fallback

variants.name: NijikaWrt
variants.base: OpenWrt 25.12 and LuCI on the Realtek 5.10 kernel. Vendor stack keeps PON, OMCI and voice

name: Peter-Pon
summary: Firmware for Lantiq Falcon GPON SFP sticks. Includes a reverse engineered Packet Engine with hardware PPPoE. PPPoE Half-Bridge is planned.

name: CatOS
summary: Firmware for RTL9601 GPON SFP sticks, developed for operator networks in Belarus.

name: ZRV OS
summary: Independent operating system for RTL9602-based ONTs, written from clean-room reverse engineering.

name: RemixWrt IIDX
summary: OpenWrt 25.12 and LuCI on Airoha EN7581 ONT gateways, starting with the Skyworth SK-G7220. Adds ONT authentication, identity and OMCI topology pages. One firmware bank keeps the stock image for recovery. Beta (r20).

name: 8311 Firmware
summary: Reference open firmware for XGS-PON SFP+ sticks. Used in 10G subscriber deployments.

name: CA8271x Firmware
summary: Open firmware for CA8271x XGS-PON hardware. Targets interoperability with Japanese operators.
